prompt: Weekly dependency update (upstream tools only: `just deps-bump` = ay lock --deps --bump, then `just deps-lock`; if those recipes are missing use `bun update` at the root and `cargo update -w`). Keep within declared requirements, no major bumps. Then run `just checkdeps`, `cargo check --workspace` and `just test`; if a bump breaks them, revert that single bump and retry. Stop when the gates pass. Do not commit: the runner commits.
